overview: Silverium Protocol (SPR) is a cyberpunk-styled DePIN dashboard where you connect a wallet, manage SPR Energy, recharge it, and spend it on AI tasks.
features: Connect an Ethereum, BNB Chain or Solana wallet and see its short address
See your available SPR Energy balance in a central panel
Recharge 10 SPR of Energy by choosing a payment method
Run an AI task that spends 1 SPR and returns a knowledge contribution
Watch a live status log of every recharge and spend
Cyberpunk dark theme with neon green and cyan accents
